description: Up to four signals packed into one polyphonic signal and one polyphonic signal unpacked into four, in 2HP

inputs.text: One of the four signals being packed; an empty jack is skipped in Auto mode and gives 0V on its channel when a fixed count is set
The polyphonic signal being unpacked into the four outputs below

outputs.text: Carries the packed signals, one channel per input, as many channels as there are patched inputs unless the menu fixes a count
Carries the channel of the unpacked input with the same position, counting E as channel 1, and 0V where the input runs out

notes: in Auto mode gaps are closed up: with only A, B and D patched the output is three channels and D lands on channel 3
a fixed channel count on the menu maps A to channel 1 and D to channel 4 whatever is patched, and lights a red mark beside the packed output
menu: 4>Poly output channels — sets a fixed number of channels for the packed output instead of counting what is patched
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
